prompt: Which method reads a single character from System.in?
choices: System.in.read() — returns the byte value as an int, or -1 at end of stream
explanation: InputStream.read() returns the next byte as an int (0–255) or -1 at EOF. For text, you must cast: char c = (char) System.in.read(). Scanner.next().charAt(0) is more convenient for token-based single-character reading.
